title: Hairstyles for Diamond Face Shape: 30 Cuts by Length
summary: Hairstyles for diamond face shape: 30 short, medium and long cuts with side parts, soft layers and bangs that balance wide cheekbones, plus how to preview them.
body_markdown:
The best hairstyles for a diamond face shape add softness and a little width at the forehead and jawline, so the wide cheekbones read as balanced rather than sharp. Side parts, side-swept or curtain bangs, face-framing layers that start below the cheekbones, and soft waves do most of the work. Styles that stay flat at the sides or pull everything tightly back tend to emphasize the angles instead.


Not sure you have a diamond face? Our[face shape test](https://www.perfectcorp.com/business/blog/general/face-shape-test) covers the measurements and all seven shapes. This guide assumes you already know, and goes straight to 30 cuts grouped by length.


## What Makes a Hairstyle Work for a Diamond Face?


- **Add width where the face is narrow:** fringe or volume near the forehead, and movement around the jaw.
- **Soften the cheekbones:** layers that begin at or just below cheekbone level, not a heavy bulk right at them.
- **Break up symmetry:** a side or deep side part softens the overall outline.
- **Use care with blunt lines:** stylists quoted by[Parade](https://parade.com/living/best-hairstyles-for-diamond-shaped-faces) and[Davines](https://us.davines.com/blogs/news/diamond-face-shape-hairstyles-men-and-women) suggest avoiding heavy straight-across bangs, very flat styles and looks that emphasize sharp angles.


## Short Hairstyles for Diamond Face Shapes


Short cuts and bobs work best with texture and a side part. For more short options across every face shape, see our guide to[short hairstyles for every face shape](https://www.perfectcorp.com/business/blog/general/short-hairstyles-for-every-face-shape) .


### 1. Deep Side-Parted Pixie


Volume swept over from a deep side part adds width to a narrow forehead.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/02/22/1d/02221d895a2f20cad1a65e95c754c74a.jpg)**


### 2. Long, Wavy Bob


A lob that hits around the collarbone, with loose waves, softens the jaw and adds width below the cheekbones.


**[Image Source](https://pin.it/3SEuXJGc6)**


### 3. Tucked-Behind-Ear Bob


Tucking one side highlights the cheekbones while the other side frames the face.


**[Image Source](https://pin.it/504rkefFl)**


### 4. Textured Shag


Soft, choppy layers around the jaw reduce sharpness and add movement.


**[Image Source](https://pin.it/5Wuq7XnR4)**


### 5. Asymmetrical Pixie


A longer piece on one side softens the cheekbones and adds movement.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/ed/cf/1a/edcf1aba8a5b2e5a819f7b5f70fe978f.jpg)**


### 6. French Bob with Light Fringe


A wispy fringe widens the forehead, and the short length shows off the cheekbones.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/d0/6e/57/d06e57fa58c01a22189fcb0fb63c0e08.jpg)**


### 7. A-Line Bob Just Below the Chin


Ending slightly below the chin, not right at it, adds fullness to the lower face without sharpening the jaw.


**[Image Source](https://pin.it/HnXQkmw6M)**


### 8. Wavy Micro-Bob


Waves add fullness at the sides for a playful, editorial look.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/59/ea/e6/59eae628f005d30bc8d1645e8c6f4e55.jpg)**


### 9. Slicked-Back Pixie, Softened


A bold option that puts the cheekbones on display. Keep some texture and lift at the crown, since a fully flat finish can sharpen the angles.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/1e/85/7d/1e857d6b2e1fdac732a047e0b3ad3c1c.jpg)**


### 10. Undercut with Volume on Top


Keep the top textured and swept to one side rather than very tall, so it adds interest without lengthening the face too much.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/9a/0c/f8/9a0cf849d2c240ae9a2dc8ece2c47a46.jpg)**


## Medium-Length Hairstyles for Diamond Face Shapes


### 11. Classic Mid-Length Layers


Layers that start around the chin soften the whole outline.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/11/43/16/114316eb68ca4f9f1a78262d94a4129e.jpg)**


### 12. Layered Cut with Curtain Bangs


Curtain bangs open at the center and add width across the forehead.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/c2/d5/b9/c2d5b9f0f243599e40c39ccf3fc6e3a9.jpg)**


### 13. Shoulder-Grazing Waves


Natural wave volume at the jawline creates balance with the cheekbones.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/e4/5f/8b/e45f8be42f8c3bd63f39f02573910398.jpg)**


### 14. Straight, Sleek Look with a Center Part


Works best on thick hair with natural volume at the sides. Add a few curved face-framing pieces, since a strict, flat center part can sharpen the outline.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/34/2c/30/342c305ee8b0b31f7b1cb11e02ca43c5.jpg)**


### 15. Feathered Cut


Light, airy layers flick away from the face and soften angles.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/68/44/f2/6844f2283312a539f41171bda0886a25.jpg)**


### 16. Blunt Cut with a Side Part


A strong, sleek look. Part it off-center and keep the ends slightly soft rather than heavy and straight across.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/ba/28/56/ba2856005b11cde24d7166747468f964.jpg)**


### 17. Retro Flip


Ends flipped out at the collarbone add width to the lower face.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/7b/6f/bd/7b6fbdc3ca8a8c450c70ef5ed62a3fb0.jpg)**


### 18. Messy, Beachy Waves


Undone texture gives effortless volume that balances the cheekbones.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/bd/87/25/bd87258eba6044b55e1d95b01f06ce57.jpg)**


### 19. Lob with Hidden Layers


Internal layers keep fullness through the mid-lengths while the ends stay light.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/6d/9e/ca/6d9eca4e2394eb4a4c4e90e17341c2df.jpg)**


### 20. Medium Hair with End Layers


Keeps hair full near the cheekbones while softening the ends.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/59/9a/bb/599abb5af8a0439516dae85ba9e450de.jpg)**


## Long Hairstyles for Diamond Face Shapes


### 21. Long Layers with a Side Part


The side part breaks up symmetry and the layers soften the chin.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/76/6d/f1/766df1295220add1e14884ce5276546c.jpg)**


### 22. Long, Wavy Hairstyle


Waves add softness through the whole frame and width at the jaw.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/ea/4f/0e/ea4f0edd2860ed8645a8f30ab5ec1628.jpg)**


### 23. Long Side-Swept Bangs


One of the most effective ways to widen the forehead and draw attention to the eyes.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/29/84/41/2984413aff399db663cc38947405a0ec.jpg)**


### 24. Long Hair with Face-Framing Layers


Layers beginning around the cheekbones or just below frame the face without adding bulk at its widest point.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/2c/ad/e4/2cade4e8626b7f5afc857fa14a876248.jpg)**


### 25. Half-Up, Half-Down


Gentle lift at the crown with loose lengths keeps the focus on the cheekbones. Leave a few face-framing pieces out.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/94/d4/d2/94d4d21fdb16f7d81c73f428a9581943.jpg)**


### 26. Voluminous Blowout


Bounce focused around the jawline adds width to the lower face.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/e6/4f/b0/e64fb0dafcf42d712f46008575dc6a2c.jpg)**


### 27. Braided Crown or Milkmaid Braid


A loose braid around the hairline adds softness and texture at the forehead.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/8b/ab/4c/8bab4c3a58a58df1f9b404647d7583a6.jpg)**


### 28. Long and Straight with a Side Braid


A braid draped over one shoulder softens the jawline.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/b2/f5/b5/b2f5b53ddc86df7acc68b3f96ef4275c.jpg)**


### 29. Long U-Shaped Cut


A rounded hemline softens the facial angles.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/a4/60/e5/a460e5b9e0a7afe1b8a839f36593dec8.jpg)**


### 30. Long Layers with Internal Volume


Hidden layers add volume without looking choppy.


**[Image Source](https://i.pinimg.com/736x/d8/35/d4/d835d4cdc97ad03b20051c08e42e1f98.jpg)**

## FAQ: Diamond Face Shape Hairstyles


### What hairstyle suits a diamond face best?


Styles with a side part, side-swept or curtain bangs, and soft layers starting below the cheekbones are the most reliable, because they add width at the forehead and jaw. Long waves, a wavy lob and a textured pixie are popular choices.


### Should a diamond face have bangs?


Usually yes, if they are soft. Curtain, wispy or side-swept bangs widen a narrow forehead. Heavy, blunt straight-across bangs can make the face look more angular.


### Is short hair good for a diamond face?


It can be. Textured pixies and cropped bobs with side bangs work well; very flat or slicked-back short styles leave the cheekbones without any softening.


### What haircuts suit men with diamond face shapes?


A sweeping fringe with soft layers, a textured crop, or a side-swept undercut keeps some length on top and softens the angles, according to[Davines](https://us.davines.com/blogs/news/diamond-face-shape-hairstyles-men-and-women) .


### Can I preview a cut before committing?


Yes. A virtual hairstyle try-on lets you see a cut on your own photo first. Face shape is only a starting point; hair texture, density and lifestyle matter just as much, so confirm the choice with your stylist.
